name: tpu-coding
description: Evidence-backed TPU coding with JAX and Pallas: layout, pipelines, numerical validation and benchmarking.

interface.shortDescription: Code and validate TPU kernels with evidence.
interface.longDescription: A maintained technical skill for Python, JAX and Pallas on TPU. Covers runtime-specific layouts, memory lifetimes, numerical controls, ranking-aware validation, fair benchmarks and scoped experiment evidence. Includes lessons from TPUBeamSearch without treating one workload as universal.
defaultPrompt: Review this TPU kernel's layout and memory lifetimes.
Design a fair JAX versus Pallas inference benchmark.
Update our TPU coding evidence after this experiment.
